description: Step-free / accessibility info for stations and docks on the demo routes. Keyed by station_id, referenced from route leg from/to ids. Source: representative of TfL Step-Free Access open data.

legend.step_free_to_train: Level access all the way onto the train (platform-train gap manageable for wheelchair)
